assets.name: fern-terraces.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original chapter 9 Emerald Vine Valley background terrain for a portrait top-down anime aircraft shooter, 1024x1536 pixels.
Reference image 1 is STYLE AND AERIAL SCALE ONLY: match its gentle hand-painted gouache anime environment, broad organic leaf/rock color patches, restrained detail, warm stone highlights and cool blue-green shadows. Create a new lush inland valley with ancient vine-covered ruins, not a harbor or the reference island.
Camera: high overhead aerial survey, looking 85-88 degrees downward. Most ground and masonry seen from above, very thin visible side faces. Terrain lies far below the plane. No low-angle canyon walls or large upright pillars near the camera.
Scene: emerald wooded river valley, jade-green freshwater channel through low irregular rocky terraces, dense layered tree crowns, moss, a few restrained climbing vines, pale old weathered masonry and small broken ruined foundations. No modern buildings. Broken bridge remains and old paving are physically anchored into the banks, matching the same perspective, ground lighting and contact shadows.
Style: broad delicately broken gouache brushwork and soft painted edges as in reference. Slight warm cream sunlight from upper right, cool jade/blue-gray shadows. Forest canopies form organic masses, no individually outlined tiny leaves. Ancient masonry is subtle warm ivory-gray, not glaring white. Moss and vines gently soften the ruins rather than burying everything in noise. Avoid photorealism, 3D render gloss, ink outlines, cartoon block shapes, neon greenery or excessive microdetail.
Composition: irregular wooded banks mostly occupy outer left 0-28% and right 74-100%, at different heights. Calm muted dark jade water dominates the central half for clear combat; soft broad currents and sparse shallow stones only close to banks. NO complete bridge or huge ruin across the central gameplay lane. Each tile is a complete coherent opaque ground/water painting; clouds and haze will animate separately and must not be baked into it.
Vertical scrolling: top 130px and bottom 130px are only calm dark jade water across the WHOLE width, matched uniform base value close to #245956 with very subtle broad brush variation. All bank/ruin forms taper and end naturally before these margins, without blurred fade or vertical cut line. Top and bottom edge water must match so scrolling into another layout has no hard seam. No vignette, poster border or black gaps.
No text, logos, UI, frame, watermark, aircraft, people, enemies, drops, equipment, modern roads, harbor cranes, ships, waterfalls or huge mist plumes.

Layout A: on the LEFT middle-lower half, a stepped green woodland terrace with a small ruined ivory-gray gateway lying in an old paved courtyard, a short path of irregular mossy stone slabs leading between trees, and a few low broken walls. Ferns and a little broad vine mass follow a low rock ledge. RIGHT upper-middle a slimmer forested rocky shelf with 3 small worn column bases, roots and scattered rocks beside quiet jade water. Ancient structures are small geographic accents, not giant set pieces.
